page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs, maintaining a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio. This dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent compute performance without resource sharing at the core level.

The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio of 4.0 GB per core. It does not include any local storage or bundled GPUs, requiring external block storage for operating systems and data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps, facilitating reliable data transfer rates for multi-tier applications.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g5.16xlarge offers a balanced resource density suitable for enterprise workloads that require high CPU core counts and a standard memory footprint without the premium cost of memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated hardware. The lack of local storage means storage costs are decoupled from compute, allowing for flexible scaling. This profile is well-suited for general-purpose enterprise applications, web serving, medium-sized databases, and distributed application nodes.
